title: obs-kubernetes contract v2 (observability package 4.0.0: Datadog Agent on a Kubernetes cluster - node Agent, Cluster Agent, cluster-checks runners; optional Fluent Bit fallback DaemonSet; no secrets)

namespace.description: namespace of the Datadog Agent release

local_service.description: internalTrafficPolicy=Local service of the node agents

host_ip_env.description: env var apps set from status.hostIP (downward API)

logs_enabled.description: true = the node Agent collects container logs (fleet policy node collector agent, 4.0.0 default); false = the Fluent Bit fallback DaemonSet does

logs_destination.description: Observability Pipelines Worker Datadog Agent source URL, 'datadog' (direct) or null when the Agent does not collect logs

ssi_enabled.description: Single Step Instrumentation by the Cluster Agent admission controller

enabled.description: Fluent Bit DaemonSet installed (fallback only: log_pipeline = fluent_bit_direct / node collector fluent_bit)

log_collector.description: the ONE collector of container logs on this cluster

agent_tag.description: Agent / Cluster Agent image tag = fleet policy agent.version (informational; null only in a plan the agent.version precondition rejects)

api_key_secret_name.description: name of the chart Secret; it holds only the ENC[dsv://...] reference, never the key
